datasets.name: 44ec0be9
queryLines:
SELECT
  CAST(MAX(net_revenue) FILTER (WHERE is_fiscal_year_to_date) AS DOUBLE) AS revenue_fytd,
  CAST(ROUND((MAX(net_revenue) FILTER (WHERE is_fiscal_year_to_date) / NULLIF(MAX(net_revenue) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_fiscal_year_to_date), 0) - 1) * 100, 1) AS DOUBLE) AS revenue_change_pct,
  CAST(ROUND(MAX(gross_margin_pct) FILTER (WHERE is_fiscal_year_to_date), 1) AS DOUBLE) AS margin_pct_fytd,
  CAST(ROUND(MAX(returns_rate_pct) FILTER (WHERE is_fiscal_year_to_date), 2) AS DOUBLE) AS returns_pct_fytd
FROM (
  SELECT `is_fiscal_year_to_date`, MEASURE(`net_revenue`) AS `net_revenue`, MEASURE(`gross_margin_pct`) AS `gross_margin_pct`, MEASURE(`returns_rate_pct`) AS `returns_rate_pct`
  FROM sales_dev.gold.sales_metrics
  WHERE (is_fiscal_year_to_date OR is_same_period_last_fiscal_year) AND (:province = 'All' OR province = :province) AND (:product_group = 'All' OR product_group = :product_group)
  GROUP BY ALL
) AS q

datasets.name: 39434e8b
queryLines:
WITH m AS (SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT `month`, `is_current_fiscal_year`, MEASURE(`net_revenue`) AS `net_revenue`
  FROM sales_dev.gold.sales_metrics
  WHERE is_current_fiscal_year OR is_previous_fiscal_year
  GROUP BY ALL
) AS previous),
f AS (SELECT MIN(month_start_date) AS first_month, SUM(forecast_net_revenue) AS rest FROM sales_dev.gold.forecast),
t AS (
  SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN m.is_current_fiscal_year AND m.month < f.first_month THEN m.net_revenue ELSE 0 END)
           + MAX(f.rest) AS fy_forecast,
         SUM(CASE WHEN NOT m.is_current_fiscal_year THEN m.net_revenue END) AS last_fy
  FROM m CROSS JOIN f
)
SELECT CAST(fy_forecast AS DOUBLE) AS fy_forecast,
       CAST(ROUND((fy_forecast / NULLIF(last_fy, 0) - 1) * 100, 1) AS DOUBLE) AS fy_change_pct
FROM t

datasets.name: 6ef3f1ac
queryLines:
SELECT
  CAST(stock_value AS DOUBLE) AS stock_value,
  CAST(in_transit AS DOUBLE) AS in_transit,
  CAST(ROUND(days_of_cover, 1) AS DOUBLE) AS days_of_cover,
  CAST(stock_out_positions AS DOUBLE) AS stock_out_positions,
  CAST(low_cover_positions AS DOUBLE) AS low_cover_positions,
  CAST(ROUND(stock_out_rate_pct, 2) AS DOUBLE) AS stock_out_rate_pct
FROM (
  SELECT MEASURE(`stock_value`) AS `stock_value`, MEASURE(`in_transit`) AS `in_transit`, MEASURE(`days_of_cover`) AS `days_of_cover`, MEASURE(`stock_out_positions`) AS `stock_out_positions`, MEASURE(`low_cover_positions`) AS `low_cover_positions`, MEASURE(`stock_out_rate_pct`) AS `stock_out_rate_pct`
  FROM inventory_dev.gold.inventory_metrics
  WHERE (:province = 'All' OR province = :province) AND (:product_group = 'All' OR product_group = :product_group)
) AS q

datasets.name: 4ab6b5b8
queryLines:
WITH last_full AS (
  SELECT MAX(month_start_date) AS m FROM sales_dev.gold.dim_date WHERE is_last_complete_month
),
actual AS (
  SELECT d.month_start_date AS month, SUM(f.net_revenue_amount) AS amount
  FROM sales_dev.gold.fact_sales f
  JOIN sales_dev.gold.dim_date d ON f.invoice_date = d.date
  CROSS JOIN last_full
  WHERE d.month_start_date BETWEEN add_months(last_full.m, -12) AND last_full.m
  GROUP BY d.month_start_date
)
SELECT month, 'Actual' AS series, ROUND(CAST(amount AS DOUBLE) / 1e6, 1) AS lkr_m FROM actual
UNION ALL
SELECT month_start_date, s.series, ROUND(s.amount / 1e6, 1)
FROM sales_dev.gold.forecast
LATERAL VIEW stack(3, 'Forecast', CAST(forecast_net_revenue AS DOUBLE),
                      'Forecast low', CAST(low_net_revenue AS DOUBLE),
                      'Forecast high', CAST(high_net_revenue AS DOUBLE)) s AS series, amount

datasets.name: 0d8802cc
queryLines:
SELECT *, CASE WHEN change_pct IS NULL THEN 'New' WHEN change_pct >= 0 THEN 'Growing'
               WHEN change_pct >= -5 THEN 'Flat' ELSE 'Falling' END AS trend
FROM (
  SELECT
    province,
    ROUND(CAST(MAX(net_revenue) FILTER (WHERE is_last_complete_month) AS DOUBLE) / 1e6, 1) AS lkr_m,
    ROUND((MAX(net_revenue) FILTER (WHERE is_last_complete_month) / NULLIF(MAX(net_revenue) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_last_complete_month), 0) - 1) * 100, 1) AS change_pct
  FROM (
    SELECT `province`, `is_last_complete_month`, MEASURE(`net_revenue`) AS `net_revenue`
    FROM sales_dev.gold.sales_metrics
    WHERE (is_last_complete_month OR is_last_complete_month_last_year) AND (:province = 'All' OR province = :province) AND (:product_group = 'All' OR product_group = :product_group)
    GROUP BY ALL
  ) AS q
  GROUP BY province
) AS previous
WHERE province IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY lkr_m DESC

datasets.name: 23a5e673
queryLines:
SELECT *, CASE WHEN change_pct IS NULL THEN 'New' WHEN change_pct >= 0 THEN 'Growing'
               WHEN change_pct >= -5 THEN 'Flat' ELSE 'Falling' END AS trend
FROM (
  SELECT
    product_group,
    ROUND(CAST(MAX(net_revenue) FILTER (WHERE is_fiscal_year_to_date) AS DOUBLE) / 1e6, 1) AS lkr_m,
    ROUND((MAX(net_revenue) FILTER (WHERE is_fiscal_year_to_date) / NULLIF(MAX(net_revenue) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_fiscal_year_to_date), 0) - 1) * 100, 1) AS change_pct
  FROM (
    SELECT `product_group`, `is_fiscal_year_to_date`, MEASURE(`net_revenue`) AS `net_revenue`
    FROM sales_dev.gold.sales_metrics
    WHERE (is_fiscal_year_to_date OR is_same_period_last_fiscal_year) AND (:province = 'All' OR province = :province) AND (:product_group = 'All' OR product_group = :product_group)
    GROUP BY ALL
  ) AS q
  GROUP BY product_group
) AS previous
WHERE product_group IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY lkr_m DESC

datasets.name: 258160fc
queryLines:
SELECT channel,
       ROUND(CAST(net_revenue AS DOUBLE) * 100 / SUM(CAST(net_revenue AS DOUBLE)) OVER (), 1) AS share_pct
FROM (
  SELECT `channel`, MEASURE(`net_revenue`) AS `net_revenue`
  FROM sales_dev.gold.sales_metrics
  WHERE (is_fiscal_year_to_date) AND (:province = 'All' OR province = :province) AND (:product_group = 'All' OR product_group = :product_group)
  GROUP BY ALL
) AS previous
WHERE channel IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY share_pct DESC

datasets.name: 9ad0c8bd
queryLines:
WITH latest AS (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) AS d FROM inventory_dev.gold.fact_stock_daily),
p AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN s.is_stock_out THEN 'Stock-out' WHEN s.is_low_cover THEN 'Low cover'
              WHEN s.days_of_cover > 120 THEN 'Overstock' ELSE 'Healthy' END AS health
  FROM inventory_dev.gold.fact_stock_daily s
  JOIN latest ON s.snapshot_date = latest.d
  LEFT JOIN inventory_dev.gold.dim_location l ON s.location_id = l.location_id
  LEFT JOIN sales_dev.gold.dim_product d ON s.product_id = d.product_id
  WHERE s.avg_daily_issued_quantity_28d > 0
    AND (:province = 'All' OR l.province = :province)
    AND (:product_group = 'All' OR d.product_group_name = :product_group)
)
SELECT health, CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE) AS positions
FROM p
GROUP BY health
ORDER BY CASE health WHEN 'Stock-out' THEN 1 WHEN 'Low cover' THEN 2 WHEN 'Healthy' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END

datasets.name: 1cf54cab
queryLines:
SELECT

datasets.name: 85c7f705
queryLines:
SELECT
  customer_name,
  ROUND(CAST(MAX(net_revenue) FILTER (WHERE is_fiscal_year_to_date) AS DOUBLE) / 1e6, 2) AS lkr_m,
  CAST(ROUND((MAX(net_revenue) FILTER (WHERE is_fiscal_year_to_date) / NULLIF(MAX(net_revenue) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_fiscal_year_to_date), 0) - 1) * 100, 1) AS DOUBLE) AS change_pct
FROM (
  SELECT `customer_name`, `is_fiscal_year_to_date`, MEASURE(`net_revenue`) AS `net_revenue`
  FROM sales_dev.gold.sales_metrics
  WHERE (is_fiscal_year_to_date OR is_same_period_last_fiscal_year) AND (:province = 'All' OR province = :province) AND (:product_group = 'All' OR product_group = :product_group)
  GROUP BY ALL
) AS q
GROUP BY customer_name
ORDER BY lkr_m DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 5

datasets.name: a3283fde
queryLines:
SELECT
  province,
  ROUND(CAST(net_revenue AS DOUBLE) / 1e6, 1) AS lkr_m,
  CAST(units_sold AS DOUBLE) AS units_sold,
  CAST(stock_out_days AS DOUBLE) AS stock_out_days,
  CAST(ROUND(depot_days_of_cover, 1) AS DOUBLE) AS days_of_cover
FROM (
  SELECT `province`, MEASURE(`net_revenue`) AS `net_revenue`, MEASURE(`units_sold`) AS `units_sold`, MEASURE(`stock_out_days`) AS `stock_out_days`, MEASURE(`depot_days_of_cover`) AS `depot_days_of_cover`
  FROM inventory_dev.gold.sales_and_stock
  WHERE (is_month_to_date AND province IS NOT NULL) AND (:province = 'All' OR province = :province) AND (:product_group = 'All' OR product_group = :product_group)
  GROUP BY ALL
) AS q
ORDER BY lkr_m DESC

datasets.name: 3ea48750
queryLines:
WITH s AS (SELECT max_by(run_id, generated_ts) AS run_id FROM sales_dev.gold.insights),
k AS (SELECT max_by(run_id, generated_ts) AS run_id FROM inventory_dev.gold.insights),
findings AS (
  SELECT 'Sales' AS area, i.severity, i.kind, i.change, i.text
  FROM sales_dev.gold.insights i JOIN s ON i.run_id = s.run_id
  WHERE i.kind IN ('revenue_drop', 'stock_out', 'anomaly')
     OR (i.kind = 'headline' AND i.metric = 'net_revenue' AND i.comparison = 'mtd_vs_last_year')
     OR (i.kind = 'forecast' AND i.dimension = 'month')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Stock', i.severity, i.kind, i.change, i.text
  FROM inventory_dev.gold.insights i JOIN k ON i.run_id = k.run_id
  WHERE i.kind IN ('stock_out_confirmed', 'overstock_total')
)
SELECT CAST(severity AS DOUBLE) AS severity,
       CASE severity WHEN 1 THEN 'Act now' WHEN 2 THEN 'Notable' ELSE 'Context' END AS priority,
       area, text AS finding
FROM findings
ORDER BY severity, area, abs(change) DESC
LIMIT 10

datasets.name: caf07220
queryLines:
WITH sales AS (
  SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'PASS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ok, COUNT(*) AS n FROM sales_dev.ops.reconciliation
  WHERE run_id = (SELECT max_by(run_id, checked_ts) FROM sales_dev.ops.reconciliation)
),
stock AS (
  SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'PASS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ok, COUNT(*) AS n FROM inventory_dev.ops.reconciliation
  WHERE run_id = (SELECT max_by(run_id, checked_ts) FROM inventory_dev.ops.reconciliation)
),
dates AS (
  SELECT (SELECT MAX(invoice_date) FROM sales_dev.gold.fact_sales) AS sales_d,
         (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM inventory_dev.gold.fact_stock_daily) AS stock_d
)
SELECT concat('Sales up to ', date_format(dates.sales_d, 'd MMM yyyy'), ' (', CAST(sales.ok AS STRING), '/', CAST(sales.n AS STRING),
              ' checks passed)  |  Stock up to ', date_format(dates.stock_d, 'd MMM yyyy'), ' (',
              CAST(stock.ok AS STRING), '/', CAST(stock.n AS STRING), ' checks passed)') AS status
FROM sales CROSS JOIN stock CROSS JOIN dates

datasets.name: d03d5b25
queryLines:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'PASS' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS failed FROM sales_dev.ops.reconciliation
  WHERE run_id = (SELECT max_by(run_id, checked_ts) FROM sales_dev.ops.reconciliation)
),
r AS (
  SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'PASS' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS failed FROM inventory_dev.ops.reconciliation
  WHERE run_id = (SELECT max_by(run_id, checked_ts) FROM inventory_dev.ops.reconciliation)
),
f AS (
  SELECT SUM(failed) AS failed FROM inventory_dev.ops.stock_rollforward
  WHERE run_id = (SELECT max_by(run_id, checked_ts) FROM inventory_dev.ops.stock_rollforward)
),
x AS (
  SELECT SUM(failed) AS failed FROM inventory_dev.ops.cross_checks
  WHERE run_id = (SELECT max_by(run_id, checked_ts) FROM inventory_dev.ops.cross_checks)
),
d AS (SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales_dev.ops.manifest_dirt) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory_dev.ops.manifest_dirt) AS n),
g AS (
  SELECT MIN(pct) AS pct FROM (
    SELECT COALESCE(agent, 'sales') AS agent, max_by(accuracy_pct, checked_ts) AS pct
    FROM sales_dev.ops.genie_accuracy GROUP BY COALESCE(agent, 'sales')
  ) AS latest
)
SELECT CAST(COALESCE(s.failed, 0) + COALESCE(r.failed, 0) + COALESCE(f.failed, 0) + COALESCE(x.failed, 0) AS DOUBLE)
         AS checks_failed,
       CAST(d.n AS DOUBLE) AS problems_caught,
       CAST(g.pct AS DOUBLE) AS genie_pct
FROM s CROSS JOIN r CROSS JOIN f CROSS JOIN x CROSS JOIN d CROSS JOIN g
